definitions.explanation: The juice squeezed from lemons, used in cooking, drinks, and as a seasoning. Can refer to both freshly squeezed juice and bottled lemon juice.

examples.japanese: レモン{汁|じる}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: To drizzle lemon juice on something.

examples.japanese: ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧レモン{汁|じる}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{加|くわ}える→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧。
examples.english: To add lemon juice to the dish.

examples.japanese: ⟦りんご→りんご：02269_ringo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{変色|へんしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、レモン{汁|じる}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{垂|た}らす→垂らす：05339_tarasu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧よい。
examples.english: To prevent apples from discoloring, it helps to add a few drops of lemon juice.

notes:
A straightforward compound of the loanword ⟦レモン→レモン：10456_remon⟧ (lemon) and {汁|じる} (juice, liquid). In recipes, レモン{汁|じる} is one of the most frequently called-for ingredients. The reading じる (not しる) is standard in this compound.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- レモン{汁|じる}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧: to sprinkle lemon juice
- レモン{汁|じる}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{絞|しぼ}る→絞る：03926_shiboru⟧: to squeeze lemon juice
- レモン{汁|じる}⟦{大|おお}さじ→大さじ：22527_oosaji⟧1: one tablespoon of lemon juice
- レモン{汁|じる}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{加|くわ}える→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧: to add lemon juice

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦レモン→レモン：10456_remon⟧⟦{果汁|かじゅう}→果汁：15335_kajuu⟧: lemon juice — a more formal term, often used on product labels
- ⟦{柑橘類|かんきつるい}→柑橘類：15619_kankitsurui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{果汁|かじゅう}→果汁：15335_kajuu⟧: citrus juice — the broader category
- ⟦{酢|す}→酢：01057_su⟧: vinegar — sometimes used as a substitute for lemon juice in cooking
